title: IEEE reference style: numbered citations and reference list

rules.text: Citations are numbers in square brackets, assigned in the order each source is first cited; ranges use an en dash, [2]–[4].
A bracketed number stands in the sentence like a footnote or as a noun (as shown in [3]); it is placed before the punctuation.
The list is numbered [1] to [n] in citation order, not alphabetically; every listed number is cited and every cited number is listed.
Authors are written initials first (A. B. Surname); up to six are listed, more than six become the first author and et al.
An article title is in quotation marks in sentence case; the journal name is abbreviated and italic, followed by vol., no., pp. and the date.
A DOI is given as doi: 10.xxxx at the end of the entry when the source has one.
